description: NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound intends to solicit and award a firm fixed price supply-type purchase order for Brand Name Bauer Compressor, Inc. SCBA Compressor Parts. See attached Solicitation posted 27 April 2026 for requirements. All responses shall be subitted prior to the solicitation closing date of May 8, 2026, at 5:00PM PDT.
